APEX CLOUD SOLUTIONS — Vendor Proposal
(SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA — for ProcureMind demonstration purposes only)

Company: Apex Cloud Solutions Pvt Ltd
Contact: procurement@apexcloud-demo.com
Phone: +91-98xxxxxxxx

PROPOSAL SUMMARY
We propose to deliver a cloud-hosted IT asset management platform for your
organization's 500-employee office rollout, including laptops, endpoint
management software, and ongoing support.

PRICING
Total contract value: USD 128,500 for a 12-month term, inclusive of hardware,
software licensing, and support. Payment terms: 30% upfront, 70% on delivery.

DELIVERY
Standard delivery timeline: 21 business days from purchase order confirmation
for full hardware rollout. Software provisioning completes within 5 business
days.

CAPABILITIES
- 24/7 support via phone, email, and dedicated Slack channel
- Cloud hosting with 99.9% uptime SLA
- API integration with existing HR and asset management systems
- Disaster recovery with documented RTO of 4 hours
- Data encryption at rest and in transit (AES-256)
- Dedicated account manager assigned post-contract
- On-site support available within 24 hours for critical incidents

COMPLIANCE AND CERTIFICATIONS
Apex Cloud Solutions is ISO 9001:2015 certified, certificate number
ISO9001-AC-2024-3317, issued by Bureau Veritas, valid until March 2027.
We are also ISO 27001 certified for information security management,
certificate number ISO27001-AC-2023-9901, issued by BSI, valid until
November 2026.
We process data in accordance with GDPR; our Data Processing Addendum is
available on request and includes a named Data Protection Officer,
registration number DPO-AC-4471.

WARRANTY
All hardware is covered by a 3-year manufacturer warranty with on-site
replacement for critical failures within 48 hours.

REFERENCES
Available upon request from three enterprise clients in the BFSI and
manufacturing sectors.
